cleavage agent: samples containing 10 mg of protein per tissue were digested with trypsin
enrichment method: phosphopeptide enrichment via IMAC (10 mg per tissue)
fractionation method: resulting peptides fractionated via strong cation exchange chromatography, prior to phosphopeptide enrichment via immobilized metal affinity chromatography
instrument: analyzed in duplicate via LC-MS/MS on an LTQ-Orbitrap mass spectrometer
labeling: Total spectral counts (TSC) were used to approximate each site’s abundance within each tissue
